what_is_closed: Tohei et al. Table I is recorded as a primary-paper table comparator with an explicit PDF locator.
The same QHA calculation reports graphite at 300 K with alpha_V=19.8e-6 K^-1 and B0=28.7 GPa.
The table also lists experimental graphite comparators alpha_V=21.9e-6 K^-1 and B0=33.8 GPa, but attributes them to different cited references.
The comparator is kept separate from a source-grade same-specimen alpha_V/K_T correction input.

equation_or_mapping.table_comparator: alpha_V(300 K), B0(300 K) from Tohei et al. Table I
equation_or_mapping.not_emitted: No numeric Cp-to-Cv correction is emitted from this table comparator.

major_result.derivation_class: primary-paper table transcription and QHA comparator boundary; no UET derivation
major_result.observable: graphite thermal-expansion and bulk-modulus comparator at 300 K
major_result.dependency_unlocked: A numeric graphite comparator lane only; no Cp-to-Cv correction, Ding C_src, base-Phi calibration, transport, Core, Gravity, or Full Topic 13 unlock.
major_result.claim_boundary: The table is evidence that a numeric graphite alpha_V/B0 comparator exists in a published source. It is not a same-specimen uncertainty-bearing thermal correction, not Ding C_src, not UET calibration, and not external validation.

source.title: Debye temperature and stiffness of carbon and boron nitride polymorphs from first principles calculations
source.source_locator: Table I, printed page 2; graphite columns; 300 K rows

table_rows.source_reference_annotation: different cited sources; not a same-specimen pair

source.uncertainty_boundary: The table gives no row-level uncertainty for either graphite alpha_V or B0. The experimental values are imported from different cited references and do not establish a matched specimen/state pair.
source.material_boundary: The paper studies graphite as a polymorph in a first-principles/QHA context; it does not establish equivalence to the Ding natural-graphite TTG specimen, morphology, isotope state, defect state, or PBTE response contract.

claim_boundary: This package records a published numeric comparator and its limitations. It does not close a source-grade alpha_V/K_T correction, Ding material mapping, C_src, base Phi dimensional mapping, independent alpha calibration, transport, or Full Topic 13.
